decisions.statement: A caller states the wait a call is given.
A caller stating no wait gives that call five seconds, and a call past its wait is at fault.
The fault names the call and the wait the call outlived.
A call being waited on never has the process open.
The timer is cleared whether the call answered or threw.
A call that answers after the wait ran out is dropped rather than raced back in.

definition: a call the supervisor gives up waiting on rather than waits out
